metadata.loading: hydrostatic preload; fixed periodic cell fluctuation eigenproblem

sampling.seed: [20261026,14,round(1000*J),sample], exactly pressure convention; seed reused across L
sampling.algorithm: checkerboard heat bath, random initial state, one draw after 3000 full sweeps
sampling.cluster: nearest-neighbour same sigma, torus seam unions included
sampling.square: largest axis-aligned uniform sigma square on torus, side <= L
sampling.ties: first lexicographic square / smallest root cluster; also min/max energy over size ties
sampling.mode: elastic-energy tile weights; PR=1/(N sum(tile_energy**2)); fixed-cell fluctuations
sampling.equilibrium: same sampler as pressure convention; 3000-sweep equilibration not independently certified
